root_cause: Missing bounds validation of an attacker-controlled length field (header_size) read from network/file input before it is used in pointer arithmetic that adjusts a buffer's base pointer and size, which are later used to compute a memset destination address.
findings: In new_pes_packet(), when a JPEG-XS elementary stream PES payload is detected (stream_id == 0xbd, stream_type == 0x32, and the 'jxes' marker present), the code reads a 32-bit header_size value directly from the untrusted packet payload (AV_RB32(pkt->data)) and immediately uses it to advance pkt->data and shrink pkt->size (pkt->data += header_size; pkt->size -= header_size;) with no validation that
